goal: Join a video visit with the doctor

page_concerns.concern: Check-in link goes to a site that isn't Bayview's

steps.title: Check in for your visit online
steps.explanation: Open the check-in link and fill in the form. This tells the clinic you have arrived for your appointment.
concerns: Form goes to calhacks.vzhsiao.com, not the clinic's own site

steps.title: Allow camera and microphone for Meet
steps.explanation: Google Meet will ask to use your camera and microphone so the doctor can see and hear you. Click Allow.

steps.title: Turn up the volume and unmute
steps.explanation: Make sure your sound is on and loud enough to hear the doctor.
steps.check_command: osascript -e 'output muted of (get volume settings)' | grep -q false

steps.title: Turn on Do Not Disturb
steps.explanation: This stops alerts from interrupting your visit. It is optional but helpful.

steps.title: Open the visit link and join
steps.explanation: Open the Google Meet link from the email. Then click Ask to join or Join now to enter the visit.
